description: This Java class, DefaultThingCommandAdapterProvider, provides various Adapter instances used for processing commands, responses, messages, events, and errors related to 'Things' in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It implements the ThingCommandAdapterProvider interface and manages adapters like query, modify, search, message, event, and error response adapters, which are initialized in the constructor using a HeaderTranslator and an ErrorRegistry.

classes.name: DefaultThingCommandAdapterProvider
